inlines.v: LEST, conjunction That not; for fear that. Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die. Genesis 3:3. The phrase may be thus explained. Ye shall not touch it; that separated or dismissed, ye die. That here refers to the preceding command or sentence; that being removed or not observed, the fact being not so, ye will die. Sin no more, lest a worse thing come to thee. John 5:14. Sin no more; that fact not taking place, a worse thing will happen to thee.
